Harness retry budget

We capped agent retries at 3 per stage and measured the change.

What we changed

  • Retry budget per stage
  • Backoff without jitter
budget = RetryBudget(max_attempts=3)
runner.attach(budget)
Cutting retries removed 41% of wasted tokens.
